tests.name: the machine and the run's state follow the compaction; a verifier for one unit and a land of one Rift are refused in the skill's words; one land of three, one batch verifier
tests.why: the run on the world: the compaction's end event and the brief after it (host law: compaction), the refusals through execute.before (host law: hooks), the children (host law: subagent), the ledger in memory; gamma's implementor is held until the brief is in, as the real run's timing left it running. The machine block against SKILL.md's own words stays real: a read of the repo's files, which a simulated file does not make

tests.name: fan-out during verify, a fold into a running implementor and one into a fix unit, the land after the verdict without the running implementor, whose finding rides with its own later land; each verifier told the folds that landed with it; a land before the verdict and one with a finding unfolded are refused
tests.why: the probe turns on the world; the held verifier answers when the test opens its gate, as the real run's model held its response; the reports are read by the plugin's own reader (filestore/findings.ts findingsIn) from files held in memory; each ungated implementor is waited out to its hand-back, as the real run's timing gave it

tests.name: a covered unit's round 2 cannot land while its batch's verifier runs; a changes whose report does not read holds the land until it reads and its finding folds
tests.why: round 1's edges on a root of their own, on a fresh world: the real run's second root shared the first's OpenCode, and its lines and lands were read apart from the first's

tests.name: a land of one of two ready units made in two places is refused; a run that keeps the machine across moves is never refused
tests.why: two plugin copies, one per location, over one ledger; the owner's moves of an idle root on the world (host law: move)
